description: Reproduction of exp107 with the new balanced-coverage scatter sampling (now default in TinyMultiHeadLut: sparse_scatter_balanced=True). Same architecture: nap=10, n_sparse_outputs=1, qk/v tph=768, out tph=4096, E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip, linear unembedder. Difference: every output slot is the destination of exactly tph*n_sparse/n_out (or ceil) tables (no multinomial spread). exp107 had per-slot min=2/max=25 with i.i.d. sampling; here qk/v slots get exactly 12, out_proj slots get exactly 10 or 11.
